title: Structura Reditus Research Library — Tier-2 Research Object Record
description: A Tier-2 research object registered in the Research Library. Controlled taxonomy fields (domain, tier2_class, structural_focus, evidence_mode, provenance, maturity, functional_locus, publication_state) are validated against taxonomy/*.yaml by the taxonomy validator; free-text fields supplement but never replace controlled values.

authors.description: Registered AuthorIDs. Every referenced AuthorID must exist in registry/authors/.

tier.description: The Research Library registers Tier-2 research records only. Tier-0/Tier-1 status is never granted by library admission.

primary.description: Exactly one primary Tier-2 class. Controlled value from taxonomy/tier2_classes.yaml.

secondary.description: Optional secondary Tier-2 classes. Controlled values from taxonomy/tier2_classes.yaml.

functional_locus.description: Controlled value from taxonomy/functional_loci.yaml (e.g. umcp, rcft, ulrc, none).

source_ids.description: SourceIDs the object depends on. Every referenced SourceID must exist in registry/sources/.

lens.description: The interpretive lens under which the object reads its material.

primary.description: Exactly one primary domain. Controlled value from taxonomy/domains.yaml.

secondary.description: Optional secondary domains. Controlled values from taxonomy/domains.yaml.

primary.description: Exactly one primary structural focus. Controlled value from taxonomy/focuses.yaml.

secondary.description: Optional secondary structural focuses. Controlled values from taxonomy/focuses.yaml.

layer.description: Distinguishes source observation from local interpretation. Never attribute a local interpretation to an external source.

primary.description: Exactly one primary evidence mode. Controlled value from taxonomy/evidence_modes.yaml.

secondary.description: Optional secondary evidence modes. Controlled values from taxonomy/evidence_modes.yaml.

relations.description: RelationIDs declared by this object. Every referenced RelationID must exist in registry/relations/.

governing_refs.description: Optional. Governing references (registry/governing/) that constrain this record. Every value must resolve to an existing SR-GOV-* record. Listing a governing reference never transfers its authority to this Tier-2 object; authority.tier remains tier-2.

version.description: Semantic version of this object record, e.g. 0.1.0.

date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of this record version with an explicit time-zone designator (Z or +/-HH:MM).

publication_state.description: Controlled value from taxonomy/publication_states.yaml. Publication status carries no admission authority.

source_boundary.description: Explicit statement of what the cited sources do and do not establish. External source-native claims stay on their side of this boundary.

authority_boundary.description: Explicit statement of what this Tier-2 object does not claim authority over (e.g. no Tier-0/Tier-1 status, no external-source endorsement).

exclusions.description: What the object explicitly does not cover.

preserved_meaning.description: For translation/mapping work: what original meaning is preserved. For other work: what invariant the object commits to preserving.

missingness.description: Declared missingness with classification. Missingness is preserved, never silently filled.

distortion_or_substitution_risk.description: Declared risk that local interpretation distorts or substitutes for source-native meaning.

next_burden.description: The next evidential or structural burden this object must discharge.

repair_route.description: The declared route by which a blocked or incomplete state of this object would be repaired.

notes.description: Free-text explanatory notes. Supplements, never replaces, controlled values.

synthetic.description: True when the record is a synthetic example/test object. Synthetic records must be explicitly marked.

supersedes.description: ObjectID of the record this object supersedes, if any. Historical versions are preserved, not overwritten.
